                                                                                         ANNEX II

                                        Statement by Italy

Italy is in favour of the proposal for a Regulation amending the Common Provisions Regulation,
while having some concerns over the effects on liquidity, since the conditions underlying the
provisions of the CRII remain relevant given that the COVID-19 pandemic is ongoing.
